description: This file defines the 'Handling' controller class within the OpenCart admin extension for total handling fees. It contains methods for displaying the handling configuration page and saving configuration settings.

classes.name: Handling
classes.description: Controller class managing the configuration of total handling fees in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the handling configuration page, loading language, setting the title, breadcrumbs, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the form submission to save handling total settings, with permission checks and JSON response feedback.
